why: The goldens pin values the firewall actually returns, so they are only meaningful against the lab this fingerprint describes. The runner checks it first and refuses to score a mismatched environment: a drifted lab must surface as a precondition failure, never as a low score blamed on the server.

services.names_are_checked_by: The `services-full-listing` golden, which pins all twelve as expected facts. They are deliberately NOT part of the precondition: reading all twelve needs a page larger than the collection, which is the exact shape a defective server fails, and a precondition that a defective server fails would report a product bug as lab drift and stop the goldens from ever running.

out_of_scope.firewall.alias: The credential-free bootstrap mints a least-privilege account, and OPNsense answers HTTP 403 Forbidden on /api/firewall/alias/search_item for it. That is the intended privilege boundary, not a defect, so no golden reads aliases — an eval that scored a 403 would be measuring the lab account.
